channel.title: NeuG Blog
channel.description: NeuG product releases, engineering insights, and real-world case studies.

item.title: Is Your LLM Knowledge Base Getting Messier with Every Update? Use NeuG to Define Concept Boundaries and Pinpoint What Needs Updating
item.description: An LLM-generated code wiki can look impressive on the first run. It turns scattered code into readable sections and produces useful explanations in very little time.

item.title: NeuG v0.1.3: The Era of Graph Computing Inside the Graph Database
item.description: NeuG v0.1.3 brings nine native graph algorithms through the GDS extension and adds COPY TEMP for temporary analysis of external data.

item.title: How Does AI Affect U.S. Employment? Replicating Harvard Business School Research with NeuGBI
item.description: NeuGBI autonomously analyzes 300 million U.S. employment records and reproduces Harvard research showing that AI-era job declines are concentrated in junior roles.

item.title: NeuG v0.1.2: Your Graph Database Is No Longer a Data Island
item.description: NeuG v0.1.2 makes the graph database a native part of the data lake ecosystem with cloud storage reads, schema-on-read, and Parquet export.

item.title: Feeding Code Repositories into LLM Wiki: 6x Token Savings in One Knowledge Build
item.description: How a repository-aware LLM Wiki ingests code, aligns modules across projects, supports team workflows, and cuts query token usage to roughly one-sixth.

item.title: You and Your LLM Can't Review Thousands of PRs at Once — But a Graph Database Can
item.description: How CodeGraph and NeuG turn large-scale pull request review into graph-powered risk scoring, conflict detection, and blast-radius analysis.

item.title: Star Counts Lied to Us: We Gave 74 Open Source Projects a Graph Database Health Check
item.description: A graph-based health check of 74 open source projects shows why Stars can conceal community decline and contributor churn.

item.title: NeuG: One Engine, Two Modes, Outperforming Established Graph Databases
item.description: Explore NeuG's embedded and service modes, full Cypher support, and benchmark results against LadybugDB and Neo4j.

item.title: Dissecting Claude Code: A Graph-Powered Deep Dive into an AI Coding Agent's Architecture
item.description: A CodeGraph analysis of 1,906 files, 9,848 functions, and 22,678 call edges reveals Claude Code's architecture.

item.title: Following 94 Million Relationships Down the Rabbit Hole
item.description: An exploratory analysis of 94 million OpenAIRE relationships reveals how the Russia-Ukraine conflict reshaped Russian academia.

item.title: We X-Rayed OpenClaw with a Graph Database — Here's the Technical Debt We Found
item.description: A graph-based analysis of OpenClaw uncovers high-risk functions, zombie code, and an over-coupled agents module hidden across the codebase.

item.title: OpenClaw Users: Why Is Your Token Budget Disappearing Out of Nowhere?
item.description: A code-graph analysis of OpenClaw reveals how its heartbeat mechanism repeatedly loads full context and quietly drives up token usage.

item.title: AI-Powered Open Source Development Management: NeuG's Exploration and Practice
item.description: How the NeuG team uses AI as a development manager across requirements analysis, task decomposition, GitHub synchronization, and progress tracking.

item.title: NeuG's High-Performance MVCC for Graph Workloads
item.description: An in-depth look at the transaction mechanism behind NeuG's high-throughput transactional processing and serializable isolation guarantees.

item.title: Opensourcing NeuG
item.description: Introducing NeuG, a lightweight, high-performance embedded graph database for local analytics and real-time transaction processing.
